## Why this change is needed

Describe the concrete problem and the relevant milestone.

## What changes

Explain the resulting behavior and affected contracts.

## Validation

List meaningful checks, outcomes, and evidence. Identify fixtures/replays and any failed or inconclusive cases. Do not treat documentation CI as application validation.

## Remaining limitations

State what is not yet supported or measured when relevant to the change.

## Handoff

- [ ] Project state and roadmap reflect actual completion.
- [ ] Session log contains the next concrete task.
- [ ] Material decisions and dependency notices are recorded.
- [ ] No secrets or private findings are included.
